items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I did "Prisoner of Love" with James Brown

ctx.x: Were these done in New York?

Yeah, we recorded them in New York. I did "Prisoner of Love" with James Brown; I did "You're a Good Man, Charlie Brown," with the Kirby Stone Four, I did the "Colonel Boogie's March" with Mitch Miller; I did "Splash Splash" with Bobby Darin, I did "Calendar Girl" with Bobby Darin; I mean Neil Sedaka, I did Calendar Girl with.
Yeah, Neil is very hot now.
